chunks: And the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةُ: The Hereafter, the life to come

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the permanence of the Hereafter compared to this world?
ai.summary: This verse, drawn from Surah Al-A'la, underscores the eternal nature of the Hereafter as the ultimate destination for the righteous, a concept central to Shia eschatology where the transient world (Dunya) is viewed as a testing ground. It invites believers to align their actions with divine purpose, reflecting the Shia emphasis on balancing worldly duties with spiritual preparation for the everlasting life (Baqa).
